ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Process Hacker Driver Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects driver load of the Process Hacker tool Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\kprocesshacker\\\.sys$") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=821D74031D3F625BCBD0DF08B70F1E77.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=F86759BB4DE4320918615DC06E998A39.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0A64EEB85419257D0CE32BD5D55C3A18.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=6E7B34DFC017700B1517B230DF6FF0D0.*")))
